title: Teach, Abstract, Apply: A Framework for Dialogue-Driven Task Learning with Collaborative Robots
abstract: arXiv:2611.00297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collaborative robots (cobots) are designed to be safer and more interactive than traditional industrial robots, share the same workspace as humans, and assist them in a range of shop-floor tasks such as palletization, joint assembly, and part inspection. Many of these tasks involve repetitive workflows that may evolve with changes in production environments and task specifications. These requirements motivate the need for intuitive interfaces that allow workers to modify workflows on the shop floor and generalise these routines for future use. This work introduces the Teach-Abstract-Apply (TAA) framework, which enables human operators to (a) teach new workflows to cobots in natural language, (b) abstract the taught workflows into skills for later use, and (c) apply these skills in different settings. translated_title: 教学、抽象、应用：一个面向协作机器人的对话驱动任务学习框架
translated_abstract: 协作机器人旨在比传统工业机器人更安全、更具交互性，与人类共享同一工作空间，并协助人类完成一系列车间任务，如码垛、联合装配和零件检测。这些任务中的许多涉及重复性工作流程，而这些流程可能随着生产环境和任务规格的变化而演变。这些需求催生了对直观交互界面的需求，使工人能够在车间现场修改工作流程，并将这些例程泛化以供未来使用。本工作提出了“教学-抽象-应用”（Teach-Abstract-Apply, TAA）框架，该框架使人类操作员能够： 通过自然语言向协作机器人教授新的工作流程； 将所教授的工作流程抽象为技能以供后续使用； 在不同的环境中应用这些技能。作为案例研究，我们将TAA框架应用于一项协作式结构搭建任务，并使用开源权重模型（Qwen3-Coder……
tldr: 本文提出TAA框架，使操作员能够通过自然语言向协作机器人教授新工作流程，将其抽象为可复用技能，并在不同场景中灵活应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Teach-Abstract-Apply (TAA) framework, which enables operators to teach cobots new workflows in natural language, abstract them into reusable skills, and apply those skills across different settings.
